subject.title: fix(ai/mistral): forward reasoning options even when model manifest disables reasoning

question: Should Mistral simple-stream reasoning requests be forwarded for manifest-disabled models, or should this fix stay limited to documented/capability-marked Mistral reasoning models?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes provider compatibility policy from capability-gated forwarding to caller-request-wins forwarding, which can affect existing Mistral configurations and cannot be treated as a routine typo fix without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow To Supported Models
options.body: Keep the manifest/known-model gate, fix the `mistral-medium-3-5` effort mapping, and require proof for the documented reasoning models only.

options.title: Accept Upstream Validation
options.body: Allow explicit reasoning to bypass the manifest gate only if maintainers want upstream Mistral to reject unsupported model/parameter pairs and require live proof for that behavior.

options.title: Use The Narrow Sibling PR
options.body: Prefer the narrower open PR if maintainers only want the model-id correction and do not want this branch's broader policy change.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Supported Models
recommendation.body: Keep the manifest/known-model gate, fix the `mistral-medium-3-5` effort mapping, and require proof for the documented reasoning models only.

likelyOwner.reason: The current direct provider file and catalog/docs copy in this checkout are attributed to steipete's recent area commit, making him the best available owner for the compatibility-policy decision.
